PURPOSE: Relationship-based authority mechanisms for PING capability-kernel: schema-driven relation/permission graph (union/intersection/exclusion/arrow composition over stored relationship tuples, permissions computed not stored), three-valued check verdict ALLOW/CONDITIONAL(missing inputs named)/DENY via partially-evaluated typed constraint expressions (write-time partial binding with write-precedence, check-time context), and causal decision tokens binding checks to (revision, origin, schema-hash) for read-your-writes and replay-at-revision.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: Conditional permission with named missing inputs: refine the capability verdict to ALLOW / CONDITIONAL(missing: [...]) / DENY by partially evaluating named typed constraint expressions split between write-time partial bindings and check-time context; partial evaluation returns the residual naming exactly which inputs are missing instead of collapsing to a silent deny. Zero-dependency pure refinement of the verdict type, ~100-line mechanism.
